item.title: CoreUI Scheduler v0.2.0 - Controlled Date and View, CoreUI Controls, Server Rendering
item.description: We are excited to announce the release of CoreUI Scheduler v0.2.0, the first release since 0.1.0-rc.0. In React, Vue and Angular, date and view are now controlled whenever you set them, so the scheduler moves only when your state does. The toolbar and the edit dialog are built from CoreUI’s own buttons and form controls, the bindings render on the server, and locales with other calendars or digits are written correctly from the hour axis to the screen reader announcements. As always, everything below is available in all four editions - JavaScript, React, Vue, and Angular.
